newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu eases to 4,000/50 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu eases to 4,000/50 vs dlr.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Romania's leu slipped on Friday, closing at 4,000/4,050 to the dollar after drifting around 3,880/3,930 over the past three days on a stagnant interbank market.
* The leu dipped some six percent against the dollar during the week but remained firmer than retail prices which stayed near 4,750.
* Foreign exchange traders said hard currency offer was on the rise with clients keen to clear their year-end leu payments before the end of the year.
* Latest central bank data show $600,000 interbank volume on Thursday, when overall trading was $19.4 million.

* Under a government decree December 30 and 31, as well as January 3 were declared public holidays. December 25 and 26 and January 1 and 2 are also public holidays under the law. In Romania, the market observes public holidays.
* Short-term rates were from 55 to 60 percent on a money market dried of leu funds. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
